critical_code_review_comments: Door-role authorization implemented cleanly: get_current_admin now requires role=='admin' (403 otherwise) for /api/admin/*, and a separate get_current_staff (admin+door) protects /api/auth/me, /api/scan/lookup, /api/scan/checkin — good separation of concerns.
LoginIn.email accepts plain str (identifier normalised via strip().lower()) which enables case-insensitive DOORSTAFF login and preserves admin email login — correctly implemented.

Result screens no longer auto-dismiss (Scanner.js scanNext is the only path back), and pausedRef in useQrScanner prevents any additional detections while a result is displayed — verified by network trace (1 request per entry, 0 during 8s wait).

camera-video is a React <video> element with playsInline+muted+autoPlay + no CSS transform (not mirrored) — spec compliant. Note: getAttribute('muted') returns null in headless because React sets .muted as a property, not attribute — this is expected React behaviour and NOT a bug (the property is true).
Diagnostics panel correctly gated behind the scanner/admin session (route + component render).
Test data isolation is intact — revenue/tickets_sold/checked_in/orders unchanged after full test-ticket rehearsal; check-in report excludes TEST rows.
